comment: Per-game driver profiles for PanVK on Mali-G615 MC2. tools/gen_driconf.py turns this into overlay/src/panfrost/vulkan/00-panvk-defaults.conf. Match is on VkApplicationInfo::applicationName, which DXVK and vkd3d-proton set to the game's .exe file name. Only add an entry with evidence (a log, a device run, a base-project worklog or several matching community configs) and say what it is in 'evidence'.

groups.title: Unity titles: cap reported video memory to 2 GiB
groups.why: Unity sizes its graphics memory from DXGI DedicatedVideoMemory and aborts with 'Crash!!!' when that is far above what is really free.
groups.evidence: Base project worklog worklogs/apps/panplay-games.md (Hollow Knight: Silksong on G615: 'Crash!!!' fixed by capping DXGI device memory to 2048 MiB). Same engine for the other entries; they run on G615 in the Winlator Mali community configs.
